Vitamins and Minerals
Vitamin and mineral supplementation is needed in all patients 
with ESLD because of the intimate role of the liver in nutrient 
transport, storage, and metabolism, in addition to the side ef-
fects of drugs (see Table 29-4). Vitamin deficiencies can con-
tribute to complications. For example, folate and vitamin B12 
deficiencies can lead to macrocytic anemia. Deficiency of pyri-
doxine, thiamin, or vitamin B12 can result in neuropathy. 
Confusion, ataxia, and ocular disturbances can result from a 
thiamin deficiency (Wernicke encephalopathy).
